basis: 1.9.8.1; existing fixed-normal sampler and monthly observation-scale API reused

reference.model: separate fixed-normal innovation priors, no hyperpriors
reference.calibration: 30-year structural effect SDs matched to seasonal reference (0.1,0.002,0.1; initial slope SD0.01)

workflow_smoke.includes: six reference responses; TXx half-slope, half-season, half-initial-slope and constant dispersion; 360-month propagation, aggregation, 95% uncertainty tables and standalone reference/sensitivity HTML
workflow_smoke.budget: 42 training months, 2 chains, 2 warmup +8 retained, 64 future paths
workflow_smoke.interpretation: Software execution only; every fit appropriately needed numerical review; not scientific results

launchers.slurm: dry run 90 one-response array elements,2 CPUs,16GiB,12h,cap32,compute startup and collection dependencies
launchers.biobot: dry run38 observation fits; local CPU/memory accounting verified; production command48 CPUs/24fit cap

checks.compact_merge: Tests use actual compact export files, rebuild routing, reject conflicting duplicates and keep posterior archives on host

limitations: No production jobs submitted on HPC or BIOBOT; runtime not measured for the full monthly study.
Startup and tiny workflow fits demonstrate execution, not convergence or goodness of fit.
Screen R-hat<1.05 and ESS>=200 are triage thresholds, not the paper convergence gate.
Monthly versus seasonal comparison is deferred; matched 30-year effects do not make the full processes equivalent.
50,000 predictive draws use repeated posterior draws; they do not increase MCMC effective sample size.
